name: Styk dvokh realʹnostey
source:
There are two men in front of you. Having something in common, however, their lives are surprisingly different.

In this story, you will need to find out whose reality is real and how much is real in each of them. And could their lives be similar to each other?

[Translated from [url=https://orinoku.itch.io/styk-dvokh-realnostei]itch.io[/url]]
